title: From bank teller to regional bank manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger in 90 seconds
summary: The first person you meet in any bank, climbing to the manager who answers for several branches; a ladder for viewers who bank, not only study finance.

beats.label: title
beats.voice: From bank teller to regional bank manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger in ninety seconds.
onScreen: From bank teller to regional bank manager, the career ladder explained with Ledger
beats.visual: Title scene: full-bleed room, a ladder on the right, the five steps below, small Ledger in the bk_teller outfit waving on the bottom step; a dashed arrow climbs to the top; the title card and the 90-second pill appear on the title words

beats.label: rung 1 THE TELLER
beats.voice: First, Ledger is the bank teller, with a name badge and a cash drawer.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (bk_teller: light-blue shirt with a bank name badge, small green visor). Header THE TELLER. Ledger alone behind a counter window, scale 3.0; arrows pop in on 'name badge' and 'cash drawer'

beats.label: rung 1 THE TELLER
beats.voice: Then he counts the drawer, and records each payment.
beats.visual: Notes are counted into a drawer; a ledger screen lists each transaction with a tick

beats.label: rung 1 THE TELLER
beats.voice: He refers loan requests to a loan officer.
beats.visual: A form slides from Ledger to a small loan officer figure at a desk

beats.label: rung 1 THE TELLER
beats.voice: So on this rung, he serves every customer himself.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.06 on 'Serves'; a queue of three customers moves up

beats.label: climb 1 to 2
beats.voice: After that, he climbs to head teller.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 1 to rung 2; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 2 HEAD TELLER
beats.voice: Now he helps the tellers, and fixes account errors.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (bk_head: grey vest over white shirt, name badge, vault key on a lanyard). Header HEAD TELLER. A wrong balance flashes red on a screen; Ledger corrects it and it turns green

beats.label: rung 2 HEAD TELLER
beats.voice: Then he sets the schedule, and stocks each drawer with cash.
beats.visual: A schedule grid fills; Ledger carries a cash tray from the vault to a teller

beats.label: rung 2 HEAD TELLER
beats.voice: So he serves a little less, and starts to lead.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.3; two tellers serve the queue behind him

beats.label: climb 2 to 3
beats.voice: Then he climbs again, to assistant manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 2 to rung 3; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 3 ASSISTANT MANAGER
beats.voice: As assistant manager, he covers for the branch manager.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (bk_assistant: navy blazer over open shirt, lanyard, pen). Header ASSISTANT MANAGER. Ledger at the manager's desk; the manager's chair is empty and he sits in it

beats.label: rung 3 ASSISTANT MANAGER
beats.voice: He also tracks the branch targets, and the daily budget.
beats.visual: A target bar and a budget meter fill on the wall

beats.label: climb 3 to 4
beats.voice: Next, he steps up as branch manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 3 to rung 4; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 4 BRANCH MANAGER
beats.voice: Now, as branch manager, he runs the branch day to day.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (bk_manager: dark navy suit, burgundy tie, pocket square). Header BRANCH MANAGER. Full branch cutaway: counter, desks, vault; Ledger stands at the centre

beats.label: rung 4 BRANCH MANAGER
beats.voice: Then he checks lending risk, and builds local ties.
beats.visual: A risk gauge on a loan form; a shop owner shakes Ledger's hand

beats.label: rung 4 BRANCH MANAGER
beats.voice: And he motivates staff, and handles complaints.
beats.visual: A complaint letter lands on his desk and is stamped resolved

beats.label: climb 4 to 5
beats.voice: Finally, he reaches the top rung, as regional manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 4 to rung 5; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: Now he oversees several branches, and reports to head office.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (bk_regional: black suit, gold pocket square, glasses, grey temples). Header REGIONAL MANAGER. Region map with three branch pins and a head office building

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: He sets each branch's plan, and counts almost no cash himself.
beats.visual: Three plan sheets slide to three branch managers; no cash in his hands

beats.label: rung 5 REGIONAL MANAGER
beats.voice: Yet he answers for every branch in the region.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.95 on 'Leads'; all three pins light up

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: So with each rung, Ledger served fewer customers, and led more branches.
beats.visual: Five Ledgers on the ladder, all five tags ticked, the slider runs from the bottom word to the top word

beats.voice: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics.

caption:
From bank teller to regional manager, the job changes on every rung

The teller serves customers at the counter, and the head teller fixes errors and stocks the drawers. Then the assistant manager covers for the branch manager. Finally, the regional manager oversees several branches

So each rung up, you serve fewer customers yourself and lead more branches. Walk up the ladder with Ledger and note which rung you are on

sources.claim: Teller duties (count the drawer, accept and record payments, refer customers to the right staff); head teller manages teller operations, schedules, errors and vault cash; tellers may advance to supervisory or managerial roles

Bank manager duties (run branch day to day, targets and budgets, lending risk, staff, complaints, local businesses) and progression customer service, assistant manager, manager, then several branches in a region

openQuestions: Title in the sources is 'bank manager'; the script uses 'branch manager' for rung 4 and 'regional manager' (several branches in a region, per National Careers Service) for rung 5. Slug renamed to ...-to-regional-manager to match the title.
BLS tellers page does not mention a branch manager; the manager rung rests on National Careers Service only plus the BLS line that tellers may reach managerial roles. A third source would be better.
Titles vary by employer and country; the caption says nothing about pay or years
